subject.title: feat: add signed run receipts with crabbox run --attest and crabbox verify

question: Should Crabbox accept `crabbox verify` as an opt-in v1 feature that validates self-signed client-side receipts for integrity only, without identity binding, execution provenance, trust roots, or transparency logging?
rationale: The code path is narrow and documented, but the permanent meaning of a PASS result is a security/product boundary that automation should not decide.

options.title: Land documented self-signed v1
options.body: After current-head proof and changelog cleanup, merge with explicit docs that receipts are tamper evidence and require out-of-band fingerprint trust.

options.title: Hold for stronger provenance
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose coordinator signing, trust roots, DSSE/in-toto, or a receipt registry before exposing a verify command.

recommendation.title: Land documented self-signed v1
recommendation.body: After current-head proof and changelog cleanup, merge with explicit docs that receipts are tamper evidence and require out-of-band fingerprint trust.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is the strongest history match for run evidence, release/security-sensitive CLI behavior, and the latest receipt hardening commits.
